verdict.rationale: Featurebase ships an official typed JS SDK (featurebase-js) with a React helper and framework-agnostic core, documented with install/boot guides and lifecycle hooks, plus a broader HTTP API (webhooks, Reports API, Training Data API, help-center endpoints) referenced in docs. However, evidence shows only one official SDK language (JS/TS) — no Python/other language SDKs — and the OpenAPI/swagger spec that would back a generated SDK returns 404, suggesting the 'API Reference' is manually documented rather than SDK-generated. Missing for 10: multi-language SDK coverage, a working machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent developer corroboration of SDK robustness.
